title: Calling George Noory's show while Bob Hastings was the guest
summary: Richard tells of Calling George Noory's show while Bob Hastings was the guest, about about 7-8 years before the recording at Coast to Coast AM radio, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Hastings was one I had talked to when I called George Dory

plain: A man named Richard, who says he once guarded nuclear missiles, says that some years ago he called in to Coast to Coast AM, a late-night radio show hosted by George Noory, while a researcher named Bob Hastings was the guest. Richard says that call was how he first talked with Hastings, which is part of how his story reached a wider audience.
